attchmntText: Please find enclosed Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by India Ratings & Research Private Limited. The report concerns the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue of 2,34,82,500 Equity Shares and Convertible Warrants at INR 73.50 per security, totaling INR 345.19 Crores. No deviation from the objects was observed. Utilization stands at INR 215.74 Crores, with INR 129.45 Crores unutilized. The unutilized amount is invested in Fixed Deposits with HDFC Bank. Repayment of loans to Malpani Parks Indore Private Limited and intercorporate loans have been completed. Part payment for operational parks acquired from Giriraj Enterprises and General Corporate Purpose utilization are ongoing.

attchmntText: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has informed the Exchange about Preferential issue of Convertible Warrants
voiceSummary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss after tax of 3,910.16 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and a profit after tax of 1,400.38 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved a preferential issue of up to 22,10,885 convertible warrants to non-promoters at Rs. 73.50 each, raising up to Rs. 16,25,00,047.50. This issue is subject to shareholder and regulatory approval. An Extraordinary General Meeting will be held on December 11, 2026, via video conferencing to seek shareholder approval for the preferential issue.
